Remote
Analytical financial analyst with experience in FP&A, budgeting, financial modeling and IFRS; comfortable working in cross-functional and remote teams. Notice period: 60 days.

Financial Analyst, GreenGrid — Nov 2025 - Present
Led monthly FP&A cycle and prepared IFRS-compliant financial statements for a renewable energy portfolio. Built Microsoft Excel models to forecast cash flows and capital expenditures, enabling a 12% reduction in working capital through tighter Budgeting controls. Collaborated with accounting on IFRS variance reconciliations and provided scenario analysis for board-level decisions.

Financial Analyst, Capgemini — Apr 2024 - Oct 2025
Owned client-facing FP&A deliverables including Financial Modeling and Budgeting for large outsourcing engagements. Developed Excel-based driver models to standardize forecasting across 5 business units, improving forecast accuracy by 18%. Supported planning workshops and communicated model outputs to stakeholders.

Financial Analyst, Pixelwave Studios — Nov 2021 - Mar 2024
Supported financial close and management reporting under IFRS for a media and games studio. Implemented SAP FICO reporting extracts to streamline Budgeting and FP&A processes; redesigned templates to reduce consolidation time by 30%. Prepared sensitivity analyses and Financial Modeling for project greenlights.

Skills: Financial Modeling, FP&A, Microsoft Excel, IFRS, SAP FICO, Budgeting, Agile, Git, Linux

Education: B.Des, NID Ahmedabad
